lines.zh: 我脑门上顶着个炸弹，一走一晃
lines.en: A bomb rides on my head and wobbles as I walk.

lines.zh: 引信在冒烟，可我不着急
lines.en: The fuse smokes, and I'm in no hurry.
Two steps and sparks fall everywhere.
My steps sound like a countdown.
Beep, beep, beep, I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，爆炸可不慢
lines.en: I walk slowly; the blast isn't slow.

lines.zh: 他们在我背后跑，我听得见
lines.en: I hear them running behind me.

lines.zh: 路边的草被火星点着了
lines.en: Sparks from me set the roadside grass alight.
There's always someone in the direction I walk.

lines.zh: 头顶那玩意儿越来越烫
lines.en: The thing on my head grows hotter.

lines.zh: 我晃脑袋，想让它凉一点
lines.en: I shake my head to cool it.
Don't follow too close; I'm not responsible.
A sound a step, and everyone wants to dodge.
My shadow trembles on the ground.
I stop, and the fuse keeps burning.

lines.zh: 嘀嘀声在安静的地方更响
lines.en: The beeping is louder in quiet places.
I tilt my head to see who runs first.
The flame on my head is small.
I count my own beeps.

lines.zh: 这东西什么时候响，我也不知道
lines.en: When it goes off, even I don't know.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，周围的人都在动
lines.en: I stand still; everyone around moves.
Something smells scorched.
I'm waiting for the right moment.
The wind bends the fuse.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，像在打招呼
lines.en: I raise a hand as if to wave.

lines.zh: 我不笑，我这张脸笑不出来
lines.en: I don't smile; this face can't.
The ground is scorched in a ring.
It's uncomfortably quiet.
You're standing just right.
One step closer and it's soon.
Do you hear the beeping?
Don't look at my head, look at my face.

lines.zh: 你是来拆我的，还是来陪我
lines.en: Are you here to disarm me, or to join me?

lines.zh: 我这张脸是从梗里长出来的
lines.en: This face grew out of a meme.
You stepped back; not very brave.
There are pits along the way I've walked.
Are you holding a bucket?
When I count to zero, it's you.
Don't think I'm a toy.
Listen, it's speeding up.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我也没什么好笑
lines.en: What are you laughing at? I'm not funny.
You hit me, and the fuse kept going.
I was knocked crooked and stood back up.
This is far lighter than the blast.
You're hitting the casing.
The beeping didn't change.
I stepped back twice; my head is hotter.
Don't hit the head; it'll go early.
Once you're done, run.
I shook and sparks flew.
Still a little time left.
You're coaxing a bomb with a gift.
I can't get that into my mouth.
I don't eat; I only go off.
Put it down and step back.

lines.zh: 这个味道不对，我要的是火药
lines.en: Wrong smell; I want gunpowder.
Give me something that makes fire.
I don't take gifts; I take time.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我炸一次
lines.en: That's not enough for one blast.
That bucket in your hand, put it down first.

lines.zh: 我不感兴趣，你也别靠近
lines.en: Not interested, and don't come close.
One bump and the fuse burns faster.

lines.zh: 你碰我的头，那是你的事
lines.en: You touched my head; that's on you.
Don't test my temper with your body.

lines.zh: 这一下，你听见嘀声变了
lines.en: You heard the beeping change.
I toppled, fuse pointing down.
Get away from me.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，我掉了点火星
lines.en: You knocked sparks off me.

lines.zh: 我不是撞不动，我是不想
lines.en: I'm not immovable; I just don't care to.
Don't push; pushing won't stop it.
The way you back away looks good.
I'm a meme; there's no such thing.

lines.zh: 两个炸弹凑一起，只会炸
lines.en: Two bombs together just go off.

lines.zh: 脑腐商人那儿还有别的
lines.en: The brainrot merchant has others.
To find a partner, look inside the meme.

lines.zh: 我头上这个才是我的伴
lines.en: The thing on my head is my companion.
Beeping is my answer.
Don't waste time here.

lines.zh: 你把这句话说给商人听
lines.en: Tell that to the merchant.
I laughed, though I have no face.
Time's short; go.
I'm balancing a bomb; my hands are busy.
I saw that iron on the ground.
Bending would tip me over.
I'll pick up what falls after the blast.
Could this be a fuse?
There's fire on the ground, don't step.
I won't take it; I don't need it.
This doesn't look explosive.
Leave it for the next me.
Someone's that way.
I walk toward the crowd.
The beeps are getting denser.
I've fixed on a back.
Not close enough.
I'll walk a little more.
That one, the fastest runner.
I won't chase; arriving counts.
My head keeps getting hotter.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，还是没有脸
lines.en: I smiled again, still no face.
Beep beep beep beep.
The beeping gets closer; you hear it.
He went behind a tree.
A tree won't stop this.
I stand on his retreat.
The beeps are nearly continuous.
He lifts a foot and sets it down.
I put my hands on my hips and wait.

lines.zh: 地上已经被烤焦了一圈
lines.en: One ring of ground is already scorched.
He shouted once.
Half a step more.
Retreating now wouldn't help.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的引信在嘶
lines.en: I hear my own fuse hissing.

lines.zh: 这不算打我，算我倒计时
lines.en: That's not hitting, that's a countdown.
One touch and he backs off.
The thing on my head hits too.
Sparks land on his clothes.
He pushed, and I got closer.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，后面会很重
lines.en: This was light; later won't be.
After the hit I stand still.
He's still standing, good.
Beep.

lines.zh: 脑腐商人把我换出来了
lines.en: The brainrot merchant traded me out.

lines.zh: 引信从第一秒就开始烧
lines.en: The fuse started burning at second one.
I stand here, beeping.

lines.zh: 头上那个东西沉得要命
lines.en: The thing on my head is desperately heavy.
I land and sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 周围的东西都退开了一点
lines.en: Everything around took a step back.
I dropped out of the meme.
Someone's here, perfect.
I swayed and straightened.

lines.zh: 嘀嘀声从这一刻起没停过
lines.en: The beeping hasn't stopped since this moment.
The wind turned when I arrived.
Fire and I are family.
I fell, and the fuse points up.
Water hit and the fuse hissed.

lines.zh: 炸开了，我又长回来一个
lines.en: It blew, and another me grew back.
An arrow struck the casing with a ping.
The spell hit and the beeping scrambled.
I don't eat; I only burn fuse.
Lightning hit my head, perfect.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在嘀
lines.en: Falling, and I'm still beeping.
